name: Omacircuit
author: Mick Donahue
description: A live-track puzzle for omarchy-shell. Cars never stop. You rotate track tiles under them to steer them onto coins, and rotating a tile a car is standing on wrecks it. Opens as an ordinary tiled window and unloads when you close it. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle io.github.labrat-0.omacircuit
